headline: Registered Nurse (Enfermeiro/a) | Medical-Surgical Inpatient Care
summary: Registered Nurse with 3.5 years of clinical experience in hospital inpatient settings and outpatient care. Registered with the Portuguese Order of Nurses (Ordem dos Enfermeiros) with an active professional license. Experienced in managing post-operative patients, administering intravenous therapy, wound care, and maintaining patient records in SClínico. Committed to delivering safe, patient-centered care as part of a multidisciplinary hospital team.

experience.title: Registered Nurse - General Surgery & Internal Medicine Ward
bullets: Provide comprehensive nursing care in a 28-bed medical-surgical inpatient ward, managing an average of 6 to 8 acute patients per shift.
Monitor vital signs, manage surgical drains and catheters, and prepare patients for pre- and post-operative procedures.
Administer prescribed medications and intravenous therapies safely, adhering strictly to hospital infection control protocols.
Document all nursing assessments, care plans, and clinical evolutions accurately using the SClínico electronic health record system.
Collaborate with physicians, physiotherapists, and healthcare assistants to coordinate patient discharges and family education.

experience.title: General Care Nurse
bullets: Performed routine nursing consultations, complex wound dressings, suture removals, and phlebotomy for an average of 20 outpatients daily.
Conducted initial patient triage and monitored patients under short-term observation following minor ambulatory procedures.
Managed clinical stock levels and ensured proper sterilization and maintenance of medical instruments.
